title: Honest Ruler: a score is not evidence

ciFast.note: The exact release commit has not yet been pushed. Local verification must pass before publication, followed by exact-head Fast verification.

ciDeep.note: The structural corpus and adversarial software fixtures are not qualified instructor reviews, adapter/base held-out trials, or a real device-speed matrix.

deploy.note: Pages deployment is pending the exact verified main merge.

liveProvider.note: This release changes the evaluation ruler and promotion admission. It makes no provider call and changes no model, adapter, prompt, or hosted inference route.

manualHuman.note: Qualified v1 held-out reviews and approved Scion training pairs remain zero. Software tests never substitute for those external judgments.

claims.summary: One versioned contract separates compiler conformance, rubric profiles, validation tier, operational evidence, and controlled effects across a 13-case corpus, nine dimensions, 26 criteria, and 23 deliverable/package rubrics.

Evidence-tier caps, critical failure caps, per-review coverage, duplicate-review rejection, explicit evidence states, and single-identity model-judge calibration prevent structural or partial evidence from becoming independent validation.

Controlled comparisons bind candidate/control arms, predeclared cases, unique trials and seeds, nonduplicated output pairs, byte-verified scorecards, qualified preferences, failures, speed, cost, and compiler burden.

Scion model promotion now requires a measured v1 comparison with five positive held-out case intervals, complete qualified blind review, a Wilson lower bound above parity, and a strictly lower compiler-call interval; legacy summary counts cannot promote.

The benchmark protocol passes structurally while held-out validation remains locked and unverified; approved training pairs, qualified adapter/base wins, and qualifying device-speed profiles remain zero, so hosted Scion remains base-only.
